newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-C&W lowered at SBC Warburg.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-C&W lowered at SBC Warburg.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc was cut to "reduce" from "hold" at SBC Warburg, the investment bank said on Monday.
Warburg said enthusiasm over last week's deal to sell part of C&W's stake in Hongkong Telecom to China Telecom had been overdone.
The investment banks said C&W would gain little until it ceded control of the Hong Kong unit to China -- which could be earnings dilutive.
C&W shares, which rocketed 74-1/2p on Friday, were down 4-1/2p at 567-1/2 by 1344 GMT.
Earlier C&W was cut to "sell" from "hold" at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson.
